title: Dependable answers 1 (D-059): unused-floor-area recorded-data semantics + bldgarea-zero-with-buildings fail-closed + coverage/section labels derived from actual evaluation
objective: Fix the three D-059 correctness findings in the scenario layer, exactly and additively within the existing contract schema (packages/contracts is FORBIDDEN - zero schema changes): (1) R002 ZERO-WITH-BUILDINGS FAIL-CLOSED - in services/api/app/scenario/unused_floor_area.py, an existing-building floor area recorded as 0 while the profile's PLUTO numbldgs fact is a positive number must NOT be consumed as a usable zero: route it to the EXISTING typed reason 'existing_building_area_unusable' (state not_computable, value null, section professional_review flag per the official PLUTO dictionary rule that zero area with buildings present means the area is UNAVAILABLE - D-059-R011); the original zero and the numbldgs basis stay traceable in the section inputs/assumptions. A recorded zero remains computable ONLY when vacancy is established by the same profile (numbldgs present and == 0); when numbldgs is absent or unusable alongside a zero area, fail closed to the same unusable reason (never guess vacancy). Correct the existing test that supplies a zero area as a 'vacant lot' without establishing vacancy (red-on-old rows for the reviewer-reproduced case: one building, bldgarea 0, positive cap -> previously computed full cap as unused). (2) R001 RECORDED-DATA SEMANTICS - in services/api/app/scenario/constants.py (and any wording emitted via builder.py), the subtraction must present itself as a limited comparison of recorded data: the existing-area input is PLUTO's recorded gross building area (condo semantics differ; NOT a verified ZR 12-10 zoning-floor-area figure - the pluto_soda connector's own source notes carry this distinction), so labels/assumptions must stop calling the result a zoning-floor-area difference or anything implying legal unused development rights; state the ZR 12-10 non-equivalence and that a rights calculation would additionally require a compatible existing zoning-area input and confirmed zoning-lot extent. (3) R003 LABELS FROM ACTUAL EVALUATION - remove the hardcoded 'draft max residential zoning floor area (R5)' coverage wording and the universal 'ZR 23-21' cap-section label: coverage descriptions and displayed section references must derive from the actually-evaluated rules (R6-R12 rows cite ZR 23-22), with tests asserting the derivation for at least one low-density and one higher-density district. Constraints: response schema shape and enums byte-compatible (contracts-typegen/schema-bundle CI jobs must stay green); no e2e edits; zero new dependencies; if any fix genuinely cannot be made without a contract-schema change, STOP that item and return a scope-block note instead of exceeding scope. Producer report to project-control/reports/M5-T027-producer-report.md.
